My research examines how [telecommunications infrastructure shapes economic outcomes](telecom-development.html) in developing countries — from mobile phone adoption and GDP growth in sub-Saharan Africa to stock market efficiency in emerging markets. I use panel data and GMM methods to address the endogeneity problems that make these questions hard.

I am a Professor of Practice in Data Science at the Connolly Alexander Institute for Data Science (CAIDS) at Tulane University. I teach courses in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and statistics. I am also the author of [*Time Series Econometrics: Learning Through Replication*](book.html) (Springer, 2nd ed. 2023).

I write about research and data science at [Substack](https://johnlevendis.substack.com).
